Definition: from G3816; to sport (as a boy):--play.
BiblicalUsage: Paizō means to play, to sport as a child. Paul warns the Corinthians not to become idolaters as some of Israel were, as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that play after idolatry is not innocent fun: the golden calf's feast turned worship into sport, and Paul says the same danger is still standing at our table.
